run_ee_pose_control: run the sawyer robot end-effector pose control example script
create_sawyer_robot: create a Sawyer robot instance with arm and gripper enabled
set_ee_pose: set the robot arm end-effector to a target pose with position and orientation
go_home_arm: move the sawyer robot arm back to its home position
review_main: review the main function that commands the robot through a sequence of target poses
